ncei:5454592.narrative: Brief touchdown over open fields.  No known damage.

ncei:5480599.title: Gentryville, Indiana
ncei:5480599.narrative: The tornado crossed into Spencer County from Warrick County just before dissipating. Some tin and insulation was found in a field at the end of the tornado track. The tornado was estimated to have weakened to F-0 strength shortly before it entered Spencer County.

ncei:5480752.title: Williams, Iowa
ncei:5480752.narrative: Brief touchdown south of the town of Williams.

ncei:5387219.title: Sewanee, Tennessee
ncei:5387219.narrative: A short lived tornado with estimated winds around 70 mph touched down near Sewanee and twisted and uprooted around 50 trees in a heavily wooded area.

ncei:5391927.title: Black Spgs, Arkansas
ncei:5391927.narrative: A weak tornado moved from southeast Polk County into southwest Montgomery County. The tornado affected areas 13 to 14 miles southwest of Black Springs, and caused mostly tree damage. The tornado was on the ground for almost 2 miles before dissipating.

ncei:5395777.title: Clear Lake, Minnesota
ncei:5395777.narrative: A weak tornado was reported by trained spotters just north of the intersection of Highway 10 and County Road 6. It dissipated northeast of town a short time later with little if any damage reported.

ncei:5396247.title: Harlan, Iowa
ncei:5396247.narrative: A tornado tracked south of Harlan near F-58 and Juniper Road according to emergency management. The tornado was also seen from near the Walnut area in extreme northern Pottawattamie county.  The tornado apparently remained in open country and caused little or no damage.

ncei:5402131.title: Hebron, Nebraska
ncei:5402131.narrative: A tornado set down in eastern Thayer county for a short time.

ncei:5412056.title: Lebanon, Florida
ncei:5412056.narrative: An eye witness saw two tornadoes rotating around each other.  Several power lines were down in the area, trees were snapped in half, and two pole barns were destroyed.

ncei:5422135.title: Prairie Farm, Wisconsin
ncei:5422135.narrative: A tornado touched down briefly, breaking several trees and destroying a shed.

ncei:5423176.title: Miccosukee, Florida
ncei:5423176.narrative: The weak tornado moved from northwest Jefferson County into adjacent northeast Leon County.  It destroyed a shed and caused minor damage to a home.  Some trees were uprooted.  Reported by a NWS employee and the Leon County EMA.

ncei:5424292.title: Jack Rabbit, Arizona
ncei:5424292.narrative: A tornado was on the ground for about 15 minutes about 10 miles east of Winslow and 5 miles north of Jack Rabbit.  The tornado was visible from Interstate 40 and an ADOT employee was able to photograph the tornado at milepost 162.

ncei:5427871.title: Avera, Mississippi
ncei:5427871.narrative: A weak tornado downed trees near Avera.

ncei:5429653.title: New Wren, Mississippi
ncei:5429653.narrative: The tornado touched down in extreme northwest Monroe County and moved east. One home had some shingles blown off its roof. One road sign was twisted. Several trees were blown down.

ncei:5332939.title: Alamosa, Colorado
ncei:5332939.narrative: A NWS employee observed two non-mesocyclone tornados (landspouts) under a towering cumulus cloud...which caused no known damage.

ncei:5346495.title: Pawnee, Illinois
ncei:5346495.narrative: A tornado briefly touched down in a field one mile south of Pawnee.  No damage or injuries were reported.

ncei:5352473.title: Boxville, Kentucky
ncei:5352473.narrative: The tornado downed numerous trees. One farm, located on Highway 56 near the junction of Highway 141,  was heavily damaged. Many trees were blown down in a wildlife area. The tornado crossed into Henderson County, where most of the structural damage occurred.

ncei:5352475.title: Clinton, Kentucky
ncei:5352475.narrative: The tornado path began on Highway 944 about 2.5 miles southeast of Fulgham. Some trees were blown down. Most of the tornado's path was in Graves County.

ncei:5355827.title: Chunky, Mississippi
ncei:5355827.narrative: This tornado caused minor roof damage to one building and downed a few trees.

ncei:5361549.title: Lono, Arkansas
ncei:5361549.narrative: A weak tornado moved from Dallas County into the extreme southeast corner of Hot Spring County about 4.2 miles southwest of Lono along Highway 9.  An eyewitness observed the tornado cross from Dallas County into Hot Spring County.  The only damage noted were a few trees that were blown down.  The tornado continued moving northeastward into Grant County.

ncei:5366958.title: Waveland, Mississippi
ncei:5366958.narrative: A weak tornado in the outer rainbands of Tropical Storm Bill touched down briefly, blowing down several trees resulting in minor damage to house roofs.

ncei:5368259.title: Iliff, Colorado
ncei:5368259.narrative: A small tornado touched down but did no damage.

ncei:5368382.title: Webberville, Michigan
ncei:5368382.narrative: A F2 tornado struck eastern Ingham county, causing two injuries. It also destroyed two homes.

ncei:5369350.title: Redby, Minnesota
ncei:5369350.narrative: A waterspout formed over Lower Red Lake for about 30 seconds.

ncei:5371783.title: Chesterfield, Virginia
ncei:5371783.narrative: F0 tornado damage on the east side of Brandermill, in the Clarendon neighborhood (near Swift Creek Middle School). Numerous trees down, with a few on homes.

ncei:5289043.title: Vienna, Illinois
ncei:5289043.narrative: This tornado was produced by the same supercell thunderstorm that spawned a long-track tornado over southern Union and southwest Johnson Counties. This tornado touched down along U.S. Highway 45, about 3 miles south of Vienna. The tornado moved east across Interstate 24, and then dissipated about 1.5 miles east of the interstate near Ganntown. Two persons were injured when their mobile home was demolished. Two other mobile homes were extensively damaged. Numerous trees were down.

ncei:5307078.title: Charleston, South Carolina
ncei:5307078.narrative: A brief tornado touch down caused some damage to a storage building for an apartment complex, shingles taken off for the most part, a couple of signs bent, and a few small trees uprooted and some limbs taken out of larger trees. The touchdown was near the CBS affiliate and not far from their Doppler radar.

ncei:5316736.title: Kingsford, Michigan
ncei:5316736.narrative: This tornado developed over northeast Florence County, WI (See Storm Data for Wisconsin, Northeastern, for more information on the beginning portion of this tornado)  and crossed the Menominee River just south of the Iron Mountain-Kingsford airport. The storm moved east-northeast into Kingsford and Iron Mountain. As the storm moved into Iron Mountain, the track shifted more to the east and the damage path became more sporadic before the tornado lifted completely on the east side of Iron Mountain.  Numerous trees and power lines were knocked down, blocking highway US-2 and disrupting electric power and telephone service.  Gas lines were ruptured and several commercial buildings sustained substantial roof damage in Kingsford.

ncei:5323000.title: Sandy Hook, Mississippi
ncei:5323000.narrative: This tornado initially developed 3 miles north of Sandy Hook and moved northeast before dissipating around 1:00 AM.  One unoccupied mobile home was destroyed, with another mobile home receiving major damage from a fallen tree.  One house had chimney damage from a fallen tree, with many other trees blown down.

ncei:5323697.title: Twist, Arkansas
ncei:5323697.narrative: The tornado touched down just southwest of Twist and moved northeast and later moved into Crittenden County. Some farm buildings were damaged. Several trees and power poles were blown down.

ncei:5326953.title: Seabrook, Texas
ncei:5326953.narrative: Tornado near the intersection of FM 2094 and Clear Lake Road.

ncei:5240239.title: Washington, Kansas
ncei:5240239.narrative: A tornado touched down near Washington and moved northeast .  The tornado damaged outbuildings, an antenna, and power poles before dissipating 2 miles north of Washington.

ncei:5251140.title: Comstock Park, Michigan
ncei:5251140.narrative: A tornado touched down near the intersection of I-96 and Leonard streets. It was classified as a F1 tornado, producing maximum estimated wind speeds of 80 m.p.h. It had a path length of only a quarter of a mile, with a width of 50 yards. Roof damage was incurred to an apartment complex, and there was also some tree damage.

ncei:5252476.title: Limon, Colorado
ncei:5252476.narrative: A small tornado touched down but did no damage.

ncei:5131512.title: Covina, California
ncei:5131512.narrative: A cold and unstable airmass generated heavy showers and thunderstorms across Central and Southern California. Numerous reports of heavy showers and small hail were received from the area. In Covina, a weak tornado developed, damaging four mobile homes. Fortunately, no one was injured. With the heavy showers, street flooding was reported in Monrovia.

ncei:5132599.title: Firth, Idaho
ncei:5132599.narrative: Near Taylorsville a mobile home and garage were destroyed, 3 houses sustained minor roof damage and a cinder block building collapsed.  Along the tornado's track, 4 center pivot and 5 wheel irrigation lines were damaged.

ncei:5135687.title: Sperry, Oklahoma
ncei:5135687.narrative: A tornado briefly touched down just north of Sperry.  The only damage was to trees.

ncei:5139189.title: Hughes Spgs, Texas
ncei:5139189.narrative: This tornado was one of several which formed over Cass County, TX.  Numerous pine and oak trees snapped and broken.  No structures were in the path of this tornado.  This tornado entered Cass County, TX from Morris County, TX.

ncei:5139361.title: Oklaunion, Texas
ncei:5139361.narrative: This tornado formed 1.5 miles southeast of Oklaunion on the south side of Highway 287 with information of its existence coming from a Doppler-On-Wheels chase team, but was later confirmed by descriptions of damage from the Oklaunion Fire Department. One tied down mobile home on the north side of Highway 287 was ripped up by the wind and strewn over a half mile area. The base of the mobile home was picked up and placed against the side of a barn 20 feet to its east. Three large barns had roof and wall damage, and one barn had several two by fours stuck sideways into its east-facing wall. Two grain storage bins had their roofs blown off, and the foundation of one bin was moved about 18 inches. One shed was damaged, and another was blown away. Also, a driver traveling on Highway 287 pulled over to the side of the road to wait out the storm and had a two by four blown through the back window. Although this tornado was rated F1, most damage is consistent with F0 damage.

ncei:5147247.title: Archer City, Texas
ncei:5147247.narrative: This tornado developed 3 miles southwest of Archer City and dissipated quickly, resulting in no damage (F0).

ncei:5160883.title: Hoxie, Kansas
ncei:5160883.narrative: Damage to utility poles from tornado.  No other damage reported.

ncei:5171320.title: Mitchell, South Dakota
ncei:5171320.narrative: A brief tornado damaged several structures.

ncei:5679989.title: Tocoi, Florida
ncei:5679989.narrative: Tornado was weak, and mainly at tree top level. Tornado originated in Putnam County and crossed the St. Johns River.

ncei:5689895.title: Logansport, Louisiana
ncei:5689895.narrative: Numerous homes with moderate to severe damage.  Some roofs removed or partially removed.  Church steeple knocked over and portion of roof missing.  Numerous trees uprooted or snapped.  This tornado was associated with a supercell which developed over the area as a speed max moved out of Texas and into Louisiana.  This is a continuation of the Shelby County, Texas tornado.

ncei:5691929.title: Atlanta, Missouri
ncei:5691929.narrative: After dissipating just west of Atlanta, a new tornado touched down 1 mile southeast of Atlanta and moved northeast into Knox County.  In Macon County, 5 single family residences and 3 mobile homes were destroyed from 2 miles east of Atlanta to 10 miles northeast of Atlanta.  Four single family homes were damaged within this area.  Several outbuildings were also damaged or destroyed.  Some damage south of the tornado track was likely due to the very intense rear flank downdraft, which storm spotters observed to accompany the storm.

ncei:5695853.title: North Bend, Nebraska
ncei:5695853.narrative: This tornado, which caused extensive damage to Morse Bluff in Saunders county crossed the Platte River just south of North Bend and damaged 14 houses in North Bend, 2 heavily.

ncei:5697838.title: Post, Texas
ncei:5697838.narrative: A brief tornado touchdown in open country was reported by the public.  No NWS survey was done.

ncei:5710298.title: Bodines, Pennsylvania
ncei:5710298.narrative: A small tornado touched down on McNamie Hill Road about 3 miles east of Bodines near Kellysburg.  The storm sheared off about 50 to 75 trees along a 1/2 mile path.  a resident on McNamie Hill Road reported seeing debris from the trees being swept in a circle as the storm passed.  The area nearby is mostly state forest land.

ncei:5715002.title: Ruskin, Florida
ncei:5715002.narrative: A tornado briefly touched down over rural south Hillsborough County on the 2900 block of 24th Street, south of 21st Avenue SE.  The tornado uprooted one large tree,  removed one quarter of a barns metal roof and snapped large branches off two additional trees before it lifted and dissipated.

ncei:5637604.title: Chowchilla, California
ncei:5637604.narrative: Initial part of this severe storm was 2 miles in length with trees damaged in the Maddalena Orchard south of Highway 152 and east of Road 10.  No other damage seen immediately to the northeast except phone line damage immediately along Highway 152  through the rural area. A spotter observed the tornado path.  While not seen directly by any witnesses there was some damage to an orchard at Ave 251/2 and Road 14 located just south and west 2 miles from Chowchilla and some building damage 2 miles due west of Chowchilla that would be the same line and direction as the observed tornado...but 4 miles farther to the northeast!

ncei:5642251.title: Crawfordsville, Indiana
ncei:5642251.narrative: Tornado touched down at CR 700S 1.8 miles west of SR47. Garage and Pole barn destroyed; barn roof damaged; trees downed

ncei:5658831.title: Eaton Rapids, Michigan
ncei:5658831.narrative: Eaton Rapids Fire Department reported a brief tornado touchdown just east of the city of Eaton Rapids, in a wooded area of northeast Hamlin Township. Eaton County Emergency Management indicated no injuries or structural damage was reported. The tornado touched down in a rural area and path length and width were not able to be determined. Damage amount was estimated and damage directly related to the tornado was limited to downed trees and power lines. The tornado was estimated to be an  F0 on the Fujita scale.

ncei:5659065.title: Tunnel Hill, Illinois
ncei:5659065.narrative: The  brief touchdown occurred just east of Tunnel Hill. Numerous trees were down, and a garage was damaged.

ncei:5605508.title: Tchula, Mississippi
ncei:5605508.narrative: This tornado initially touched down 1 mile south of Tchula and moved northeast to 2 miles east southeast of Emory. The path width and strength varied along the path, but at its widest point was 200 yards. The worst damage occurred at a school 2 miles east of Tchula where major damage was done. Fortunately the the school was almost vacant. Along the remainder of the path mostly F1 and F2 damage occurred. Several houses were damaged and one mobile home was flipped over. Of course numerous trees were blown down along the entire path.

ncei:10317293.title: Tyronza, Arkansas
ncei:10317293.narrative: A tornado briefly touched down knocking down a few trees.

ncei:10330234.title: Madison, Mississippi
ncei:10330234.narrative: The tornado began at 0310 five miles west-southwest of Flora and traveled in an easterly direction and lifted five miles southwest of Canton at around 0330. Three mobile homes were totally destroyed. A two story house was almost totally destroyed and two of the occupants were injured.  A pickup truck in front of this house was picked up and hurled into a lake nearly 100 yard behind the house. At least five houses had roof damage. Two houses under construction were leveled. Numerous trees, fences, and small buildings were blown down along the path of the tornado.

ncei:10328365.title: Starks To, Louisiana
ncei:10328365.narrative: A small tornado destroyed a few barns along a path that began in Starks and ended about 5 miles northeast of Starks.

ncei:10335749.title: Red Cloud, Nebraska
ncei:10335749.narrative: Tornado touched down five miles south of Red Cloud and moved northwest.  A home was damaged just south of Inavale.
